gaps.explanation: 'Applause' is the noun; 'applaud' is the verb.

gaps.sentence: ___ (FORTUNE), the package had already been delivered.
gaps.explanation: The sentence adverb is 'Fortunately' — luckily for us.

gaps.sentence: The mountain road has been ___ (WIDE) to cope with coach traffic.
gaps.explanation: Passive 'has been widened' — the verb form meaning made wider.

gaps.sentence: He made a full ___ (RECOVER) after six months.
We owe our success to her ___ (VISION) leadership.
There were three ___ (BURGLE) on our street last month.
gaps.explanation: 'Three burglaries' — plural noun for the crime; burglars are people.

gaps.sentence: The new ___ (GOVERN) takes office in May.
The law was introduced to stop ___ (CHEAT) by companies.
